verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The same equation, solved in the signed square root instead of in μ. Lean sets r := varianceRoot a δ v = √(ρ/a) (varianceRoot_sq: r² = correction δ v / a = ρ/a) and μ := solveScale d p r; solveScale_variance then gives tiltVariance d p μ = r² = ρ/a, which is (C.10) with V = tiltVariance (tiltVariance_eq_extended_integral identifies it with ⟨(t−t_s)²⟩). The range clause is stated separately and in the paper's own variables by FamilyChoices.amplitude_bound: 0 ≤ μ < maxAmplitude, where maxAmplitude is fixed by the field amplitude_large (3/aMin < tiltVariance d (p₂ x) maxAmplitude), the Lean form of (C.7). Existence and uniqueness are exists_unique_nonneg_variance_parameter, proved for every V ≥ 0 and every μ ≥ 0 rather than on [0, μ_max) — a larger range than the paper's, so nothing is lost. seedTilt_variance states the realized identity ⟨(t−t_s)²⟩ = ρ/a for the constructed tilt.
